workflow_steps.name: Field Work

workflow_steps.delay_point: unexpected grounding or mast issues are noted in photos but not normalized

workflow_steps.name: Inspection Scheduling
workflow_steps.repeated_judgment: choose whether the site is ready or whether more prep is needed for older-home edge cases

workflow_steps.data_saved_well: yes for booking, weakly for readiness context

workflow_steps.name: Correction Loop

moat_hypotheses.title: Older-home service repairs have repeated grounding and service-equipment failure clusters
moat_hypotheses.business_problem: Repeat corrections on older-home service work create extra truck rolls and margin loss.
moat_hypotheses.local_signal: Dallas residential permit and inspection histories for service repairs in older South Dallas and Oak Cliff housing stock.
moat_hypotheses.evidence_we_expect: Failed inspection notes repeatedly mention grounding, mast, meter-socket, or service-equipment issues on similar job types.
moat_hypotheses.why_generic_models_miss_it: The pattern depends on local housing stock, Dallas inspection language, and the contractor's actual callback history.
moat_hypotheses.value_if_true: The company can build an older-home readiness checklist that prevents avoidable first-pass failures.
moat_hypotheses.test_plan: Group failed-to-passed sequences by ZIP code and job type, then compare repeated failure labels and recommended-next-action outcomes.

moat_hypotheses.title: Reviewed correction paths can be normalized into a reusable older-home reinspection playbook
moat_hypotheses.business_problem: Crews rely on memory to interpret terse failed inspection notes, which creates inconsistent corrections.
moat_hypotheses.local_signal: Failed inspection notes, callback texts, and reinspection outcomes for residential service and rewire jobs.
moat_hypotheses.evidence_we_expect: The same few correction steps recur before successful reinspections on comparable jobs.
moat_hypotheses.why_generic_models_miss_it: The best next action depends on local inspector phrasing and what this business actually changes before passing.
moat_hypotheses.value_if_true: A ranked next-action recommender could shorten callback loops and reduce office coordination time.
moat_hypotheses.test_plan: Create reviewed label rows that map failed notes to the correction steps that preceded a pass, then score recommended-next-action quality.

moat_hypotheses.title: Neighborhood slices can predict which older-home jobs need deeper pre-inspection prep
moat_hypotheses.business_problem: Some neighborhoods generate recurring surprises that were not captured at estimate time.
moat_hypotheses.local_signal: Permit addresses, ZIP codes, property age proxies, and inspection results for residential electrical jobs.
moat_hypotheses.evidence_we_expect: A subset of ZIP codes shows concentrated correction patterns tied to detached garages, older panels, or service-mast work.
moat_hypotheses.why_generic_models_miss_it: These are locality-specific housing patterns, not general electrical guidance.
moat_hypotheses.value_if_true: Estimating and inspection readiness can be tailored by neighborhood before material or crew time is committed.
moat_hypotheses.test_plan: Run pattern extraction over grouped permit and inspection slices by ZIP code, permit subtype, and outcome path.

The business already saves enough permit, callback, and photo evidence to test whether repeated correction paths can become a local operational moat.
